description: Občinske ceste v Občini Mokronog-Trebelno is a dataset listed in Slovenia’s open data, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by OBČINA MOKRONOG - TREBELNO. The collection contains a list of categorized municipal roads in the Municipality of Mokronog-Trebelno. Coverage: OBČINA MOKRONOG - TREBELNO. The portal shows the English title as "Municipal roads in the Municipality of Mokronog-Trebelno" (machine-translated by the portal). The publisher named on the listing is OBČINA MOKRONOG - TREBELNO. Its keywords include Lokalne ceste, javne poti. The listing shows 3 download or service links in HTML, CSV, XLSX. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support transport network, traffic and access studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-odprti-podatki-slovenije.
